candidates.locator: page 3, section part_i, Section A item 1 (Outfalls 001)
candidates.exact_span: During the period beginning the effective date of the permit and lasting through the dismantle of Outfall 001, the permittee is authorized to discharge storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water from Outfalls 001.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The authorized discharge window and the specific discharge types define when Outfall 001 monitoring and limit obligations are in force versus when no-discharge or post-dismantle periods may apply; different readings of effective date, dismantle timing, or which waters are authorized change which FY2025 periods require monitoring and how missing-evidence cases are classified.
